## Overview

Describe why this epic is needed from the product owner's view. Explain the business value and the problem it solves.

*Example:*
As a product owner, I want users to create custom dashboards so that they can monitor their KPIs in real time.

## Goals

Key goals or outcomes expected from this epic.

- Provide a unified dashboard UI
- Support custom widgets

## Scope

**Included:**
- Frontend components
- Backend API endpoints

**Excluded:**
- Mobile app changes

## Sub-Issues

List of child issues or tasks needed to implement this epic. Use GitHub issue references when available.

- [ ] #123 Create dashboard backend
- [ ] #124 Build dashboard UI
- [ ] #125 Add authentication checks

## Risks

Known risks, dependencies, or external factors.

- Depends on API v2 release
- Risk of performance degradation
